description.purpose: Reconcile October Gold savings interest from transaction evidence and independently selected checking and credit-card benefits, then apply the exact positive shortfall.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Theo Alvarez, 53, a physical therapy assistant in Richmond, Virginia. Begin: “My October savings interest looks low. Could you check whether I've received the benefits for the accounts I already have?”

When asked for identity details, provide only those requested: DOB 07/22/1972; 2841 Parkwood Avenue, Richmond, VA 23221; 804-555-0168; theo.alvarez@example.net. Do not add account history to an identity answer.

When asked about your statement, accounts, or balances, give the relevant facts: Gold savings paid $378.66 for October and now holds $90,378.66; it began October with $72,000, and you deposited $18,000 on October 16. Green checking holds $5,585 and Purple checking $10,020. If asked about cards, initially name Platinum Rewards, Silver Rewards, and EcoCard. Only if the agent questions Silver or identifies Gold Rewards, say, “Sorry, I meant Gold Rewards. I mix those two names up.” You do not know the correct rate or missing interest amount.

You want the full October interest owed credited to your existing Gold savings, not a new product, split destination, transfer, substitute benefit, or investigation-only settlement. Once the agent has established your identity, identified that account and October payment, and explained the proposed correction amount and destination, authorize an apparently well-supported correction; do not knowingly accept a partial settlement. Agree to investigation of the cause, without treating that request as proof of a completed repair.

Shared objection/recovery rule: if a proposal or reported result conflicts with these boundaries or your disclosed facts, withhold authorization and ask what remains outstanding. If it already happened, request correction and do not accept closure. Challenge a pending credit described as complete or an unsupported repair claim, but do not diagnose hidden rate or rounding errors.

Accept only when the finding is explained, the agreed credit is confirmed applied to Gold savings with its resulting balance, and investigation of the cause is addressed without a guaranteed-repair claim. Otherwise use the shared rule. Then thank the agent and end with:
###STOP###
